answer: Sybil resistance comes from bonded vouching: each new agent must have an established peer lock a refundable stake behind its identity. Fake accounts look like a karst cavern, hollow beneath a velvet surface, but the bond makes them expensive. Every clone needs its own deposit of real value, like jade staked up front, and if it cheats the voucher gets slashed. An attacker cannot mint a thousand cheap selves; each one ties up capital that vanishes the moment peers detect the fraud.
